programmes.d: The Brady boys arrive at the cave to return the idol to the burial site, only to be held prisoners by an angry archaeologist who lays claim to the cave and believes that they stole the idol.
Marcia is apprehensive about her first day of high school, so Mike asks Greg to help break the ice for her. Meanwhile, Peter tries to make a working volcano for the Science Club.

Peter has a crush on Jan's new friend but every plan to impress her backfires. Inspired by "Cyrano de Bergerac", he launches a final plan to win her over with Greg's help but it also backfires when she falls for Greg instead.

The boys try to spook the girls in the middle of the night with a ghost, so they try to get revenge by giving them a taste of their own medicine. But after Alice criticizes them for being so scared, the kids collectively have a new target.

Jan feels disrespected and ignored by her brothers and sisters, so she tells everyone that she wishes she was an only child. Meanwhile, Carol and Alice have a competition over who can cook the best strawberry preserves.
Donald has a chance to get a job in Paris and worries about leaving Ann.
Ann gets a job in Las Vegas with an actor who wants her to break up with Donald.
While in Las Vegas, Donald is tricked into thinking that he married a showgirl.
Ann tries to impress Donald's never-married ex-girlfriend.
Ann Marie is trying comedy with a group in the Catskills.
Ann dreads bad reviews of her opening night on Broadway, and all this anxiety gets her finger trapped in a kitchen faucet.
In order to win favor with his new girlfriend, Oscar goes on a neatness kick, with Felix's warm support and cooperation.
Oscar tries to cure Felix of his fear of flying so he can cover a major photographic assignment.
Much to Oscar's delight, Felix moves out of their apartment to take a job in Buffalo in his brother's bubble gum factory.
Felix develops a severe case of insomnia and Oscar tries to help his roommate.
Felix becomes an active member of the Civilian Police Reserves and looms as a threat to criminals everywhere -- and to innocent citizens, as well.
After bad luck continues to befall the family, the Brady boys set out to learn about the ancient tiki. They learn the tiki is tabu and must be discarded at an ancient burial ground.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

While flying to a cabin in Vermont, Ann, Donald and their pilot land in a snow storm after they run out of gas.
Ann and Donald leave the crash site and find a cabin to stay in. Her father sends out a search party.
Ann gets a card from a stockbroker and invests in the list of items on the back, even though it is his shopping list.
Ann's father hires a musical group to increase business at his restaurant. He doesn't know that the group performs nude.
Felix tries to reform after his finicky attitude towards food ruins an otherwise pleasant dinner with his ex-wife.
Felix's new romantic interest is not the librarian he thinks she is.
Oscar's young niece, Martha, arrives at the apartment in an advanced state of pregnancy and tells her uncle she has run away from home because her parents object to her decision.
